# Espresso Dial-In

Start at a 1:2 ratio: 18 g in, 36 g out, in 28 to 32 seconds.

## When it tastes wrong

- Under-extracted shots are sharp and acidic: grind finer or run longer.
- Over-extracted shots are bitter and dry: grind coarser.

Change one thing at a time. See [[Grinder Maintenance]] if the grind drifts.
